jobDescription:
ServiceNow ITOM / Discovery Consultant

Location: Germany / Hybrid
Employment: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Area: ServiceNow ITOM, Discovery & CMDB

Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow ITOM / Discovery Consultant to support the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of our ServiceNow IT Operations Management environment. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience with ServiceNow Discovery, CMDB, MID Servers, infrastructure discovery, and troubleshooting. The consultant will work closely with infrastructure, application, security, and ServiceNow platform teams to improve the accuracy and completeness of configuration data.

Key Responsibilities
- Configure, maintain, and optimize ServiceNow Discovery.
- Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot MID Servers.
- Configure Discovery schedules, IP ranges, credentials, and behaviors.
- Troubleshoot Discovery errors and investigate failed or incomplete discoveries.
- Maintain and improve the quality of ServiceNow CMDB data.
- Work with CI classes, relationships, identification rules, and reconciliation rules.
- Develop and maintain ServiceNow Discovery Patterns where required.
- Support discovery of Windows, Linux, network, database, and cloud infrastructure.
- Work with infrastructure teams to resolve credential, firewall, network, and access issues.
- Support Service Mapping and application dependency mapping.
- Implement CMDB health monitoring and improve completeness, correctness, and compliance.
- Support integrations between ServiceNow and external infrastructure/monitoring systems.
- Create technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
- Participate in ServiceNow upgrades, testing, and release activities.
- Work within Agile/Scrum teams and collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.

Required Skills
- 4+ years of ServiceNow experience
- 2+ years of ServiceNow ITOM/Discovery experience
- Strong ServiceNow Discovery knowledge
- Strong CMDB knowledge
- MID Server configuration and troubleshooting
- Discovery Patterns
- Identification and Reconciliation Engine / IRE
- CI classes and relationships
- Windows and Linux infrastructure knowledge
- Networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, SNMP and SSH
- REST/SOAP integration knowledge
- ServiceNow scripting, including JavaScript
- Troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
- Good English communication skills

Nice to Have
- ServiceNow Service Mapping
- ITOM Visibility
- AWS/Azure discovery experience
- ServiceNow CSA certification
- ServiceNow CIS-Discovery certification
- ITIL knowledge
- Agile/Scrum experience
- German language skills
